title: Fee-free USDS/USDC convertibility for Osero depends on a Sky Core spell that has not yet executed
content:
A.6.1.1.7.2.6.1.2.1.1.3.2 states: "The ALM Proxy for the Osero Diamond PAU will be whitelisted on the litePSM in an upcoming spell. This will allow it to call `buyGemNoFee` and `sellGemNoFee` on the `MCD_LITE_PSM_USDC_A` contract, enabling no-fee USDS and USDC swaps through the PSM."

The entry documents a capability in the future tense, and the gating action belongs to someone else. A spell is a Sky Core governance execution, so this permission is granted by the protocol's own governance rather than by Osero, its operators, or its token holders. Osero cannot unblock it.

The capability itself is significant for an Agent whose mandate centres on stablecoin liquidity: fee-free conversion between USDS and USDC is what lets a liquidity layer move between the ecosystem's unit and the wider dollar market without leakage. Until the spell lands, that leg is closed and any USDS/USDC conversion must take another, costlier route.

Recording the dependency in the Artifact is the notable practice. Rather than describing only the current state, the document names the pending external action, which makes the gap between designed and available capability auditable — and, as with the deferred parameters elsewhere in the Artifact, means removing the caveat later will itself be a visible edit.
description: A.6.1.1.7.2.6.1.2.1.1.3.2 records the ALM Proxy's litePSM whitelisting as pending, so a documented capability is not yet available to the Instance.
